newsitem.title: USA: Western Pa. battle heats up over sales tax vote.
newsitem.headline: Western Pa. battle heats up over sales tax vote.

text.p: The battle over a proposed sales tax increase in western Pennsylvania began heating up this week, after the Legislature approved a bill placing the idea on the November ballot.
The state Senate followed the House's lead on Thursday and approved a referendum on a half-percent sales tax increase to appear on the November ballot in ten Western Pennsylvania counties.
The revenues would be used to build a new professional baseball stadium in Pittsburgh and expand the city's convention center.
The Allegheny Institute On Public Policy invited commissioners from the ten counties to talk about why they should lobby against the measure.
Institute officials say the only county to benefit from the money generated would be Pittsburgh's Allegheny County. Most of the commissioners in attendance said they were against the proposal.
